title: Fibonacci auto-line + triple-EMA filter grid EA (Advance Robot #11)
entry_long: EMA5>EMA100 and EMA5 crosses below EMA12 (candle_id1) draws fib_buy retracement line from 90-candle high/low; when price crosses up any fib level (0,23.6,38.2,50,61.8,78.6,100) open buy 0.1 lot, delete fib_buy line after entry
entry_short: mirror: EMA5<EMA100 and EMA5 crosses above EMA12 draws fib_sell line; price crosses down any fib_sell level -> open sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>5 pips; trailing stop 15/step5 once trade count>=2 (follow-mode only, disabled in reverse-mode); follow-mode adds every 2x grid_distance(30 pip) in trend direction; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with optional L_Plus lot increment (default 0)
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap (none present); flat-lot test (L_Plus=0, already default) to isolate fib+EMA entry edge before judging; author's own 5yr in-sample backtest only, needs OOS
novelty_note: auto-drawn Fibonacci retracement (90-candle lookback) gated by triple-EMA cross as entry trigger; fib-level entry idea is somewhat novel vs plain EMA-cross EAs in this catalog

title: Triple-EMA simultaneous-cross candlestick EA (Advance Robot #12)
symbol: EURUSD (also demoed on XAUUSD with adjusted params)
entry_long: candle_id1 and candle_id2 bullish candles, candle_id1 open above EMA5; candle_id2 close crosses above EMA5, EMA8 and EMA12 simultaneously -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: candle_id1/2 bearish, candle_id1 open below EMA5; candle_id2 close crosses below EMA5, EMA8, EMA12 simultaneously -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>10 USD (close_Money); trailing stop 15/step5 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode); follow-mode grid every 2x(20 pip)=40 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with optional L_Plus increment
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap; author gives separate XAUUSD parameter set (candle_pip 50, close_Money 300, grid/reverse distance 400, trailing 300/30, L_Plus 0.01) worth testing as a second home; flat-lot verification needed before trusting 200%+/500%+ in-sample gains
novelty_note: requires all 3 EMAs crossed by the same candle close - stricter than typical dual-EMA cross; low-to-moderate novelty

title: Williams %R + EMA200 trend-filter grid EA (Advance Robot #13)
entry_long: candle_id1 close above EMA200 and Williams %R (candle_id1) crosses above -80 (exiting oversold) -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: candle_id1 close below EMA200 and Williams %R (candle_id1) crosses below -20 (exiting overbought) -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>10 pips; trailing stop 10/step1 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode); follow-mode grid every 2x(15 pip)=30 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with L_Plus=0.05 lot increment per add
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap; author reports 5yr in-sample gain 471% on EURUSD H1 tick-model but no OOS/holdout shown - needs re-verification and flat-lot isolation of WPR edge
novelty_note: Williams %R overbought/oversold entry with long-EMA trend filter; standard reversal-in-trend idea, low novelty

title: EMA-crossover with lookback + pullback confirmation grid EA (Advance Robot #14)
entry_long: EMA_fast crossed above EMA_slow at any candle within lookback window candle_id15-24, EMA_fast still above EMA_slow currently, and current price pulls back below EMA_fast -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: EMA_fast crossed below EMA_slow within candle_id15-24 window, still below currently, and price pulls back above EMA_fast -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>10 pips; trailing stop 10/step1 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode); follow-mode grid every 15 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with L_Plus=0.05 increment
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap; author's 5yr in-sample result had relative DD ~58% - needs flat-lot and OOS check before any deploy consideration
novelty_note: scans a 10-candle window for a prior EMA cross plus a pullback-to-fast-EMA confirmation before entry, reducing false immediate-cross entries; moderate novelty vs plain crossover EAs

title: EMA-cross martingale gold scalper (Go Robot scouting basic)
entry_long: EMA_fast(5) crosses above EMA_slow(12) -> buy 0.1 lot, SL=100 pip, TP=100 pip
entry_short: EMA_fast(5) crosses below EMA_slow(12) -> sell 0.1 lot, SL=100 pip, TP=100 pip
exit: fixed SL/TP=100 pip per order; on TP-hit (win) next order in same direction reopens at base lot 0.1; on SL-hit (loss) next order reverses direction and doubles lot size (lot_x=2, uncapped repetition)
buildon_idea: add a max-step cap (e.g. 5-6 doublings) or switch escalation to linear-add/log to remove ruin risk; flat-lot test (disable doubling) to check if the EMA5/12 cross alone has any edge before crediting the martingale for the demoed profit; author explicitly states this EA is not usable in all market conditions
novelty_note: plain EMA cross entry with classic double-on-loss / reset-on-win martingale money management; low novelty, high structural risk as shown (no cap)

title: Three-candle continuation pattern (soldiers/crows) grid EA (Advance Robot #15)
entry_long: candle_id4, candle_id3, candle_id2 all bullish (min body 4 pip) and candle_id1 close still above candle_id2 open (shallow pullback, not breaking down) -> buy 0.1 lot fixed
entry_short: mirror: candle_id4/3/2 all bearish and candle_id1 close still below candle_id2 open (shallow pullback) -> sell 0.1 lot fixed
exit: close all when combined profit>10 pips; trailing stop 10/step1 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode); follow-mode grid every 15 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with L_Plus (0.01 used in test) lot increment
buildon_idea: author himself suggests: add a max-order cap (e.g. MaxOrder=15) to limit grid risk, and swap the engulfing reversal filter for RSI/Stochastic/Williams%R/EMA-cross as alternate confirmation - both directly actionable; 5yr in-sample gain only 62% (weaker than sibling EAs), worth comparing after fixes
novelty_note: three-bar continuation (soldiers/crows) with a shallow-pullback filter as first-entry trigger; author flags it as an unoptimized teaching example

title: Auto-drawn trendline break + EMA50 confirm grid EA (Advance Robot #16)
indicators: auto-drawn trendline (highest/lowest over N candles, N=50 or 90 vs 15)
entry_long: price closes above auto-drawn TR_LINE_buy (connects highest-high of last 50/90 candles to highest-high of last 15 candles) AND price crosses above EMA50 -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: price closes below auto-drawn TR_LINE_sell (lowest-low based) AND price crosses below EMA50 -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>10 pips; trailing stop 10/step1 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode, trendline generation paused while a position is open); follow-mode grid every 20 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with L_Plus=0.05 increment
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap; author notes viewers found the 50-candle trendline noisy and switched to 90-candle lookback mid-video - worth sweeping N as a lever; 5yr in-sample gain >400% but relative DD 72.5% is high, needs OOS/flat-lot check
novelty_note: auto-generates a trendline object from rolling highest/lowest-over-N reference points (not a fixed indicator) as a breakout signal, then confirms with EMA cross; the auto-trendline construction itself is a reusable building block worth cataloging

title: Bugfix: duplicate-order glitch in reverse-mode grid logic (follow-up to Advance Robot #16)
entry_long: n/a - bugfix/admin video, not a new strategy
buildon_idea: n/a - documents and fixes a bug where reverse-mode's re-entry condition was identical to the grid-check condition, causing a duplicate order to fire on a 1-pip price move instead of waiting for the full grid distance; fix = disable the block wired to noted_nearby's invert/inverse output so reverse-mode only re-enters after the full grid distance is met, same as follow-mode
novelty_note: not a mechanism card; useful only as a known gotcha note for anyone implementing the follow/reverse grid pattern seen across EX068-EX076 in this same series
